Found 305 items in registries @dashboardblocks:

Showing items 1-305 of 305:

- activity-feed (registry:component) - Primitives for activity feeds: a list with connectors that line up with the markers, tinted icons by tone, an unread dot, relative times and "Today" and "Yesterday" day headings that take a fixed now and a time zone, and grouping by day. [@dashboardblocks] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- ai-usage (registry:component) - Primitives for LLM usage: token cost at per-million prices with cached input billed separately, cache savings and hit rate, compact token and dollar formatting, model colours in a fixed order and an input, cached and output token bar. [@dashboardblocks] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- alerts (registry:component) - Primitives for alerts: critical, warning, info and resolved severities, each with an icon and label, plus relative time formatting. [@dashboardblocks] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- animated-number (registry:component) - An animated number component. [@dashboardblocks] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- animated-wave (registry:component) - An animated wave component. [@dashboardblocks] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- app-shell (registry:component) - Primitives for app shells built on the shadcn sidebar: navigation sections from data with active links, badges and collapsible child links, a brand link, a workspace switcher, sidebar and avatar user menus, a top bar, breadcrumbs, a search button with a keyboard shortcut, a notifications bell, plan usage and a top navigation row. [@dashboardblocks] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- chart (registry:component) - Chart components. [@dashboardblocks] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- auth (registry:component) - Primitives for signing in and joining a workspace: a full-page frame with one narrow centred column, a one-time code input with a box per digit that handles paste, autofill and Backspace, a square workspace avatar with initials, and an email masking helper. [@dashboardblocks] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- billing (registry:component) - Primitives for subscription billing: currency formatting, MRR movement from starting to ending MRR, net revenue retention, a waterfall of the movement and an invoice status badge. [@dashboardblocks] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- block-state (registry:component) - Primitives for loading, refreshing, empty and error states: a skeleton, a dimmed frame that keeps its layout while it refreshes, a message with an action, and a data-loading hook. [@dashboardblocks] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- breakdown (registry:component) - Primitives for part-to-whole breakdowns: a segmented 100% bar, legend keys and share formatting. [@dashboardblocks] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- chart-panel (registry:component) - Primitives for full-size chart panels: tooltip, legend, axis defaults and an accessible data table. [@dashboardblocks] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- checklist (registry:component) - Primitives for checklists and steppers: done, in progress, to do and skipped states, each with a marker shape and label, progress maths that leaves skipped steps out, and a styled checkbox. [@dashboardblocks] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- data-table (registry:component) - Dashboard tables on TanStack Table: sorting, search, facet filters, pagination, row selection and column visibility, with inline bars and a stacked layout for narrow cards. [@dashboardblocks] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- command-menu (registry:component) - Primitives for a command menu: a search dialog of pages, actions and records that filters as you type or shows results you fetch, with descriptions, shortcuts and a searching state, a search button with ⌘K, and a shortcut hook. [@dashboardblocks] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- comparison (registry:component) - Primitives for comparisons: deltas, a two-proportion test with a 95% interval, diverging bars, dumbbells and an interval bar. [@dashboardblocks] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- dashboard-header (registry:component) - Primitives for dashboard headers: a date range preset menu, a compare switch, filter menus, filter chips and an export menu. [@dashboardblocks] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- deployments (registry:component) - Primitives for deployments: ready, failed, running, queued and rolled back statuses each with an icon and label, duration and short commit formatting, DORA bands for deployment frequency, lead time, change failure rate and time to restore, a DORA badge and a run history strip. [@dashboardblocks] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- distribution (registry:component) - Primitives for distributions: quantiles from raw values or from binned counts, binning, a five-number summary, the share above a limit, round ticks, a histogram with labelled percentile and threshold lines and an outline for an earlier period, a box plot, an axis and legend keys. [@dashboardblocks] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- error-pages (registry:component) - Primitives for error and interruption pages: a full-page frame with your brand, a centred message, an optional code and icon, actions and footer links, plus UTC time and duration formatting. [@dashboardblocks]

  Add command: `[object Promise]`

  Add command: `[object Promise]`

- forecast (registry:component) - Primitives for forecasts: a straight-line fit with a prediction interval that widens with the horizon, run-rate projection, date-to-target solving, a striped projection bar, legend keys, a tooltip and a status badge. [@dashboardblocks] 
  Add command: `[object Promise]`
